mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase corporate profit margins through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal coordinated monetary easing and labor market tightening, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth economic regimes with GDP growth above 3.0% and housing starts exceeding 1500.0 thousand units, consumer spending accelerates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 3.0% and HOUST > 1500.0, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 105.0 index level signals robust manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that trigger Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market recovery regimes with employment growth exceeding 50k and unemployment decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points, consumer spending accelerates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 50k and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through elevated corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
